## In the offing

**Word Power 62 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Likely to happen soon.

### Usage

1. In view of the rise in Omicron cases, night curfew is in the offing.
2. I have heard there are more staff changes in the offing.

### Your turn

Use “in the offing” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
